Tiny Robot Watch

A homemade round smart watch, also a robot face and a pendant. Below runs the real watch code, so it looks and plays just like the little screen.

Try the watch

Tap and swipe it with your finger or mouse.

Tap an appDouble-tap = home Tap the time = gamesSwipe the pixel clock Hold 2 s = next faceHold in a game = game list

The 3D-printed case

Drag to spin it. These are the real print files.

What's inside

  • Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-S3 (the brain)
  • Seeed Round Display for XIAO, 1.28" 240 × 240 touch screen
  • 1000 mAh LiPo battery (40 × 30 × 8 mm)
  • Case printed in PLA, with a twist lock, no screws

What it can do

  • Paw menu with six apps, the time and battery in the middle
  • Two clocks, plus a pixel clock with 8 scenes that react to touch
  • Googly robot eyes with six moods
  • Pixel games: runner, miner, bubbles, catch, hop and bonk
  • Message bubbles and stickers sent from a phone over Wi-Fi
  • Paint, photo slideshow, brightness, and sleep to save battery
Made by hand, one tiny pixel at a time.
